title: Sister, woman 68: sounds weird on the phone, words won't come out

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's for my sister, she's at 19 Vicente Street. I'm on my way there.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I just called her and she sounds weird on the phone. Her words won't come out, she keeps trying and stopping.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We talked at 11 and she was fine.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is anyone with her right now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, she lives alone. Please hurry.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way to 19 Vicente Street.
